entries.zh: 隨：依隨、順從（照他人心意而行）
entries.en: to follow, to comply with; to go along with another's will
entries.notes: 西语词头（hacer a voluntad…de ellos）OCR 残损，义据汉字「随」与音写 Jūy 定。

entries.zh: 款：按条理、次第安排（款有理路、体式之意）
entries.en: to arrange in due order; order, proper arrangement
entries.notes: 汉字带[疑]（款/歉），西语尾段（smo trasporto）残损，词义暂定为「有秩序地做」。

entries.zh: 以手搧风、招风取凉
entries.en: to fan the air with the hands; to waft a breeze
entries.notes: 汉字「樾」与音写 iēr 音义皆不合，疑为摇／曳之讹，仅据西语释义定。

entries.zh: 造作：制作、营造（泛指动手做、制作器物）
entries.en: to make, to build, to fabricate

entries.zh: 創置：创建、设立（新造、置办）
entries.en: to establish, to found, to set up

entries.zh: 做翁婆：结为夫妻、成婚（翁婆即夫妻）
entries.en: to become husband and wife; to marry, to live as man and wife
entries.notes: 西语残形可读作 hacer vida maridable（过夫妻生活），与汉字、音写相合。

entries.zh: 痢症：患痢疾、下痢（汉字疑作「瘉症」）
entries.en: dysentery; to be down with dysentery (reading uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语词头严重残损，汉字带[疑]，音写 līn chû 对应不明，仅据汉字栏暂定。

entries.zh: 努盡氣力：竭尽全力、使出全部气力
entries.en: to exert all one's strength; to do one's utmost

entries.zh: 阿意順從：曲意迎合、顺从他人心意
entries.en: to comply with another's will; to humor, to defer to

entries.zh: 佮伊主意：与他的心意相合、顺他的意思（佮，与、同）
entries.en: to accord with his intention; to suit his will

entries.zh: 柔順：温顺听话、柔婉顺从
entries.en: gentle and obedient; compliant, docile

entries.zh: 隨願：顺遂心愿、如愿以偿
entries.en: according to one's wish; as desired

entries.zh: 隨意：任凭己意、随心所欲
entries.en: at will; as one pleases

entries.zh: 越：越过、逾越（超出所命范围）
entries.en: to go beyond, to overstep; to exceed what is commanded
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（仅存 mandan 可辨），音写作 vat : cōi vat（越／过越），义据汉字与音写暂定。

entries.zh: 曝鹽：晒盐、以日光晒取盐
entries.en: to make salt by solar evaporation; to sun-dry salt
entries.notes: 汉字[疑]仅为盐／塩异体之别，不影响词义。

entries.zh: 煎鹽：煮卤煎盐、以火煮成盐
entries.en: to make salt by boiling brine

entries.zh: 用心照理去做、依道理行事（汉字疑作「東心做」）
entries.en: to act according to reason; to do with care and in order
entries.notes: 西语 conforme a la razón 与汉字「東／查心做」对应不稳，音写 tǒng sīm chō 义难定。

entries.zh: 變化：变更、改易（骤然变动）
entries.en: to change, to transform; a sudden change
entries.notes: 西语末字缩写「m」（疑为 mutación／mudanza）须展开，义据汉字「變化」定。

entries.zh: 妄動：轻举妄动、不循道理地行动
entries.en: to act rashly; to move without reason or order

entries.zh: 妄人：狂妄无知、行事不循理之人
entries.en: a reckless, senseless person; one who acts without order
entries.notes: 汉字带[疑]（濛/妄），且西语为动词短语而汉字为名词，词性不合。

entries.zh: 摻做：混杂着做、不按规矩地乱做（音写重叠 lām-lām 表杂乱）
entries.en: to do in a haphazard, mixed-up way; to muddle things together

entries.zh: 解釋：解说、辩明（音写末段「bu laxau」污损不可辨）
entries.en: to explain, to expound; to clear up (tail of the transcription illegible)
entries.notes: 西语作「庇护行善」（hacer bien amparando），与汉字「解釋」不合，且音写带 T99 污损，义难定。
